definition.strict_gallery: Sequence-available HVIDB-2104 viruses only (n=1,115); no IntAct non-nominal augmentation.
definition.unreachable: True partner absent from the strict gallery; contributes 0 to end-to-end Hit@K and is excluded from Recall@T|reachable / oracle@T.
definition.ranking_note: Per-query Stage-1/Stage-2 indicators for reachable queries are taken from the deposited augmented-gallery (n=1,229) evaluation; removing the 114 non-nominal decoys can only improve or leave unchanged a reachable query's rank, so reported reachable-subset rates are conservative lower bounds under the strict gallery.
